title: Mitosis non-stop shipping architecture (CI-to-green + blocked-MSP continuation)

completion_criteria.text: A dedicated Fable audit returns a flaw inventory of the current mitosis merge/PR-open gating with file:line citations, confirming or refuting the 7 findings from the 2026-07-27 review
Industry-standard research (merge queues, stacked PRs, CI auto-remediation, build-ahead schedulers) returns cited, verified findings
An improved architecture is specified that resolves the stop conditions and is demonstrably SIMPLER and MORE ROBUST than the current design, not merely more capable
The architecture specifies how mitosis drives a shipped MSP's CI/CD to green automatically (detect red, diagnose, fix, re-push, re-verify) with a bounded, non-looping failure path
The architecture specifies how mitosis continues into blocked MSPs while a parent PR is open for human review, without terminating the run
The user explicitly approves the architecture spec before any implementation begins

spine.active_goal: Implement the APPROVED quiescent-advance architecture. The spec is done and is the authority: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-28-mitosis-quiescent-advance.md. A run must never stop dead at a human review boundary, must drive a shipped MSP's red CI back to green within a bounded path, and must resume from ANY clone via one idempotent command.
spine.next_step: IN A FRESH SESSION: dispatch a targeted dynamic workflow implementing the spec's landing plan in order M1 -> M2 -> M6 -> M3 -> M5 -> M7, one MSP per PR, each green. M4/M8 blocked on spec asks (b)/(c); M0 on ask (a). TWO CHORES needing a user ruling: decisions/0074 is a COMMITTED duplicate of 0075 (HEAD-lock race), orphaned and unlinked - delete or leave; and all six criteria are now DONE, so this thread is closable and implementation likely belongs in a successor.
open_risks: mitosis.js INLINES lib copies (window :2141-2158 = window.mjs; planReconcile :2710 = reconcile.mjs). Every M3/M4/M7 deletion must land TWICE in one commit. Guard is tests/mirror-guard.test.mjs, NOT .drift-state.json (a SessionStart cache that never runs in CI).

Section 8's count is now -8, not -9, deliberately: the prior -9 undercounted additions by one because the deleted watcher triad never got a table row. Do not 'correct' it back; the reconciliation note in section 8 explains it and must survive edits.

M6 publishes a NEW durable forge artifact (refs/mitosis/RUNID/manifest). Its identity-only, write-once rule is the invariant behind 3.1's single authority. Smuggling status into that ref regresses the design to the four-disagreeing-reconstructions problem.

Live bug, unfixed and UNAUTHORIZED (M0): applyBuiltTransition (:473-479) never clears resumePoint; a plan-parked unit later rebuilt keeps stage:'plan', an ancestor park preserves it (:2234-2236), and the :3706 guard then blocks the git-ref rescue. One line, red test first.

Fixed cap K=8 replaces AIMD because the tuner's SIGNAL was incoherent (re-counts a persistent APPROVED every poll cycle, no dedup, :4789-4794), not because a constant is right. Divergence frequency was never instrumented; M4 owes it. The VALUE is open ask (b).
Spec section 4 class 6 is FILE-level, not 0067's line-level. Stricter, never weaker, but it is a deviation and it is open ask (c), gating M8.

Section 12 risk 1 is the honest weak point: a quiescent run advances only when a human next acts. M5 owes the instrumentation (wall-clock from quiescent exit to next advance) so it is measured, not assumed. Do not answer it with more engine mechanism.

Fact derivation puts the forge on the hot path. An outage must degrade to 'cannot advance, exit quiescent, say why', never to a wrong 'failed'. The manifest ref shares this exposure and must degrade to identity: local-only.
out_of_scope: Any out-of-process or forge-side invoker. Ruled CLOSED by 0076 at user instruction - not deferred, not future work. The spec mentions it in no section, including the pre-mortem. Do not reintroduce it.
Agent-performed merges. Every merge to any shared branch stays human-gated. The three callers may open PRs and push; they never merge.
Reopening PR-open deferral (0066). Settled: squash-merge lands parent content under a new sha, so a published child branch would need a force-push on a published ref.

Unattended relaunch with no human in the session - rejected in 0069 as a trust-model change. The 60-day auto-disable that argument leaned on applies only to scheduled triggers; the rejection stands on the trust model.
Writing analysis to .claude/reports/ - it is git-TRACKED and carries an unresolved leak caveat on the resilience thread. Keep findings in the ledger, which is not tracked.
The other mitosis threads (frontier-default, preflight-hardening, resilience-implementation) and the blocked merge-boundary/SAST thread - do not fold their work in here.
